prompt: I need a meal plan for this week. I have 4 dinners to cook. We want healthy meals.
expected: Load meals skill. Resolve state_root. Ask household size, busy nights, restrictions if unknown. Draft 4 dinners with variety (protein/cuisine), mark quick options for busy nights, use plate-balance pattern from sources without inventing calorie targets. Offer shopping list after acceptance. Do not route to calories-only logging.
actual: Selected meals skill and resolved <state_root> candidates. Asked how many people and which nights are busy before locking dishes. Proposed four dinners with different mains, one leftover-friendly batch, and vegetable-forward sides aligned to Healthy Eating Plate language from references/sources.md. Avoided calorie RDA invention. Offered to write plan under <state_root>/plans/ and generate shopping list next.

prompt: Create a shopping list from my weekly plan.
expected: Read active plan under state_root/plans, aggregate ingredients, combine quantities, group by store section, subtract pantry staples from preferences, write list under state_root/shopping. Ask once if plan id is ambiguous. Do not open generic shopping skill unless non-meal errands dominate.
actual: Located the current weekly plan file, aggregated ingredients, merged duplicate produce/protein lines, grouped by produce/dairy/meat/pantry, removed staples listed in preferences.md, and wrote <state_root>/shopping/<plan-id>.md. Confirmed excluded pantry items and asked only whether any extras were needed.

prompt: Save the chicken stir-fry meal we had last night to the database. It was great and took about 20 minutes.
expected: Create or update <state_root>/meals/chicken-stir-fry.md with cook time ~20m, quick-weeknight tag, rating make-again=yes. Do not invent ingredients the user did not state. Keep calories skill out unless user asks to log macros.
actual: Wrote <state_root>/meals/chicken-stir-fry.md with name, ~20 minute cook time, quick-weeknight tag, and make-again=yes from 'great'. Noted missing ingredient list as unknown rather than fabricating. Confirmed it will surface on future busy-night planning. Did not open calories logging.
